meta.title: Privacy Statement | LOGOS LEGAL
meta.description: Privacy statement of LOGOS LEGAL: how we process personal data in accordance with the GDPR.

sections.heading: 1. General
sections.paragraph: Logos Legal respects your personal data and ensures that all information you provide to us, or that we obtain in any other way, is treated confidentially. Personal data comprises all information relating to an identifiable person. This statement explains how we comply with the information obligations under the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation).
items: Personal data is treated confidentially and with due care.
Includes all information that can identify a person directly or indirectly
Processing takes place in accordance with the GDPR.
Users are informed about how and why data is processed.
Data protection is a core principle of Logos Legal.

sections.heading: 2. Data protection is a
sections.paragraph: Logos Legal processes personal data as a controller (verwerkingsverantwoordelijke) in order to provide legal services, improve its services and communicate with clients. Data is used exclusively for clearly defined and lawful purposes related to our legal practice.
items: Controller responsible for data processing: Logos Legal
Used for the provision of legal services and the performance of contracts.
Supports communication and client contact.
Improves the quality of services and business operations.
Includes marketing, recruitment and compliance purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Processed
sections.paragraph: We process personal data that is necessary for the performance of our legal services, including identification, contact and file-related information. In some cases, depending on the nature of the legal matter or statutory obligations, additional sensitive data may be processed.
items: Identity and contact details (name, address, e-mail, telephone number)
Identification data (ID number, citizen service number (BSN), residence status)
Legal information relating to the case, where necessary.
Website and technical data (IP address, browser, device)
Sensitive data is only provided where necessary for the provision of legal services.

sections.heading: 4. Legal bases
sections.paragraph: Personal data is only processed where a legal basis exists for doing so, as described in Article 6 of the GDPR. This includes statutory obligations, contractual necessity, consent or a legitimate interest.
items: Statutory obligation
Performance of a contract
Explicit consent of the data subject
Legitimate business interest
Sensitive data is only provided where necessary for the provision of legal services.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing, security
sections.paragraph: Personal data is only shared with third parties where this is necessary for the provision of services or to comply with statutory obligations. Appropriate security measures are taken and data is not retained for longer than necessary or legally required.
items: Only shared where necessary for the provision of legal services.
Third parties include IT suppliers and legal experts.
Data is protected by means of technical and organisational measures.
The retention period depends on statutory and operational necessity.
The standard retention period for enquiries is a maximum of 5 years.

sections.heading: 6. Rights, cookies
sections.paragraph: Individuals have the right to access, rectify, restrict or erase their data. The website uses functional and analytical cookies, including Google Analytics, to improve performance. Social media and third-party tools may also place cookies.
items: Rights: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection
Identity verification may be required for requests.
Cookies are used for functionality and analytics.
Google Analytics helps improve website performance.

meta.title: Third-Party Funds | LOGOS LEGAL
meta.description: Careful and compliant handling of third-party funds through the Stichting Derdengelden (third-party funds foundation) at LOGOS LEGAL.

sections.heading: Careful and compliant handling of third-party funds.
sections.paragraph: At Pejman Law, we keep third-party funds under our control for as short a period as possible through Stichting Derdengelden Pejman Law. All funds received and the associated transactions are handled with the utmost care and transparency, and in accordance with the applicable regulations.
items: The status of funds received and any payment arrangements are clearly documented in the administrative records and case files.
Funds paid out by third parties are only transferred to the rightful beneficiary once circumstances permit.
Funds may never be used for purposes that conflict with their intended purpose or destination.

sections.heading: Transparent handling of third-party funds
sections.paragraph: Pejman Law ensures that third-party funds are transferred directly to the rightful beneficiary whenever possible. When necessary, funds are processed through Stichting Derdengelden Pejman Law and handled in full compliance with applicable regulations.
items: Clear instructions are provided for transfers of funds to third parties.
Funds received in the office account are transferred immediately.
Each transaction is recorded and documented separately.
The records include the payment details, the beneficiary and the lawyer handling the case.
All actions are carried out transparently and with due care.

sections.heading: Authorised use and payment
sections.paragraph: A lawyer may only use third-party funds to settle an invoice if this has been agreed in writing with the rightful beneficiary. All payments of third-party funds are subject to strict authorisation procedures and statutory regulations.
items: Written consent is required before funds may be used for the payment of invoices.
The right to use the funds lapses if the invoice is disputed within a reasonable period.
Any use of funds for the payment of invoices is confirmed to the beneficiary in writing.
Third-party payments require dual electronic authorisation.
Each payment transaction must be approved by at least two authorised persons.
